title: receipt_print: a receipt that rises, tilts, and prints its lines with a jolt
goal:
From Krish's Character.ai cut (docs/ve/styles/character-ai-receipts.card.json, gaps). Build device `receipt_print`: a cream receipt card that rises about 250 px with a tilt from -3 to -1.5 deg and a 1 deg settle wobble, then prints its lines one by one. As each line prints, the card jolts 2 px with a doubled ghost image for 3 frames, and the line's figure fills mint on the same frame. Verbs: enter, add (one line per event), highlight. Fixture: a five-line receipt over one beat; device.test.ts asserts the jolt frames, the ghost and that the card stays inside its box.

Per devices/CONTRACT.md: index.tsx, state.ts, schema.ts, fixture.json, device.test.ts; register in registry.ts and config/ve/devices.json.
contract: Device rules: apps/renderer/src/engine/devices/CONTRACT.md. One clock (useCurrentFrame only in apps/renderer/src/engine/clock.ts). Pure functions of props, no Math.random, no wall clock. Colour roles from tokens, never raw hex. Every number carries its producer. In a layout region (kit/layout.ts isRegion, kit/staging.ts) the device lays out at its natural size and grows to fill the region (kit/regionFit.tsx).
